operator_invitations_live_key.name: operator_invitations_live_key
operator_invitations_live_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

knowledge_entries_one_current_per_topic.name: knowledge_entries_one_current_per_topic
knowledge_entries_one_current_per_topic.where: published_at is not null and effective_to is null

knowledge_published_requires_operator_co.name: knowledge_published_requires_operator_confirmation
knowledge_published_requires_operator_co.value:
published_at is null or (
        provenance = 'operator_confirmed'
        and confirmed_by is not null
        and confirmed_at is not null
        and effective_from is not null
      )

knowledge_published_requires_a_real_pers.name: knowledge_published_requires_a_real_person
knowledge_published_requires_a_real_pers.value:
published_at is null or (
        confirmed_by_membership_id is not null
        and published_by_membership_id is not null
      )

vehicle_availability_live_booking_key.name: vehicle_availability_live_booking_key
vehicle_availability_live_booking_key.where: booking_id is not null and released_at is null

payments_live_kind_key.name: payments_live_kind_key
payments_live_kind_key.where: state in ('due', 'paid') and label is null
